scenes.flow_prompt: Cinematic pull-back shot showing full developer dual-monitor workstation with glowing code on screen.
scenes.camera_motion: Smooth pull back and fade to channel brand card.
scenes.voiceover: Is Neovim right for you? Keyboard purists, Linux sysadmins, and power users who demand total control over their IDE. Subscribe to IDE Guide for daily editor breakdowns!
